description: This bar chart, titled "Recall@10", illustrates the performance metric Recall@10 for four distinct methods: "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking". The horizontal axis displays these four categories in the order listed, while the vertical axis represents the Recall@10 score, scaled linearly from 0.1 to 0.4, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The bar labeled "Ours" is colored brown and reaches a value of approximately 0.35. The bar labeled "- critiquing" is dark blue and reaches a value of approximately 0.3. The bar labeled "- scoring" is also dark blue and reaches a value of approximately 0.15. The bar labeled "- ranking" is dark blue and reaches a value of approximately 0.23. All bars are presented without any grouping or stacking, and there is no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding applied to any of the bars. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, appearing in the sequence they are labeled on the x-axis.
